driveSpeed.note: Logged drive time ÷ the drawing's time; 0.83-1.25 on 2 Nov (1.5 was the light chassis).

spinUpS.note: Median of 83 spin-ups to launch speed; 0.9-2.1 s, slowest on a low battery.

volleyS.note: Settle (0.2-0.7 s) plus the set 3.5 s feed; the last ball leaves about 2.4 s in.

intakeFullS.note: Last piece a median 1.5 s after the push starts, plus about 0.4 s to latch full.

tipStartS.note: No TIP after our volley logged yet; ball flight is about 0.5-0.7 s.

tipSwingS.note: Two hand-tipped swings read 0.43 and 0.57 s; a TIP on 8 POLLEN is not logged yet.

tipLoad.note: Field Setup Guide 12.3: an empty raised CELL tips on 8 POLLEN.

startLoad.note: 3 NECTAR start in the raised CELL, so the 3rd POLLEN tips it.

volleyLoad.note: 4 POLLEN if every shot lands; lower it for misses.

partnerTipLagS.note: Partner's last shot to our CELL seen up: flight, dwell, swing, camera; 1.5-5 s in the simulator.
